# Straum

> Straum is an experimental, clustered MQTT 3.1.1 and 5 broker. It sends a PUBACK only after a majority of its nodes has committed the message to one replicated log. TLS for clients and between nodes, credentials and topic rules work, off by default. It is ready to try and test, not yet for production: flow control, published Linux measurements of failover and performance, persistent sessions and wills are still to come; QoS 2 and shared subscriptions are planned for a later phase, and a cluster starts at three nodes.

## Docs

- [What is Straum](https://straum-io.github.io/start/introduction/): purpose, status, feature table, comparison
- [Quick start](https://straum-io.github.io/start/quick-start/): a three-node cluster on one machine
- [Install](https://straum-io.github.io/start/install/): Docker, Debian packages, Kubernetes
- [Architecture](https://straum-io.github.io/concepts/architecture/): gateway and sequencer, slots, majority commit, handoff and takeover
- [Guarantees](https://straum-io.github.io/concepts/guarantees/): what a PUBACK means, memory bounds, failure behavior
- [Configuration](https://straum-io.github.io/reference/configuration/): every STRAUM_* variable and fixed limit
- [Metrics](https://straum-io.github.io/reference/metrics/): the stable Prometheus metrics
- [MQTT support](https://straum-io.github.io/reference/mqtt-support/): feature matrix and reason codes
- [Limitations](https://straum-io.github.io/project/limitations/): what Straum does not do yet
- [Benchmarks](https://straum-io.github.io/project/benchmarks/): methodology; no figures published yet

## Projects

- [straum](https://github.com/straum-io/straum): the broker (Apache 2.0)
- [straum-cli](https://github.com/straum-io/straum-cli): terminal client (Go)
- [straum-console](https://github.com/straum-io/straum-console): read-only web console (early: web pages and a JSON API, on loopback)
